Subject: Meeting about the room booking service

Dear facilities team,

Thank you for asking about our room booking service last week. I would like to visit your office to walk you through the setup. The meeting should take about an hour.

Here are the times I can offer. Please pick the one that suits you best.

- Tuesday, 2026-10-13 at 14:00
- Wednesday, 2026-10-14 at 10:00
- Thursday, 2026-10-15 at 15:00
- Friday, 2026-10-16 at 11:00

On the day, we will count the rooms, check the doors, and note where each panel could go. It would help to have a floor plan of the building ready. Your facilities manager should join us for the second half.

We will send a quote within three days after the meeting. The price depends on the number of rooms, the length of the contract, and the number of panels. There is no setup fee.

After the visit, we can lend you two panels for a free trial of one month. Your staff can try them in the two rooms they book most often. At the end of the month, we take the panels back unless you decide to keep them.

If you would like to discuss anything before we meet, just reply to this email. I will call you if I have not heard from you by the end of next week. The quote will reach you soon after our visit. Please take as long as you need to decide.

Best regards,

Ichiro
Sales team
